subject: POC intake: prompt & evaluation data — next steps and owners
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Green <ellen.green@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC intake: prompt & evaluation data — next steps and owners

Hi Ellen / Sam —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can start the POC next week: 

1) Deliverables we need from Greenleaf before kickoff (please share via Drive or S3):
   - Prompt set: CSV with one prompt per row + metadata columns (customer_id, intent_tag, expected_answer). Target ~500 prompts to start (can be smaller if you want us to augment).
   - Historical chat logs (redacted): recent anonymized user-assistant logs, up to ~10k messages; you can provide a sampled subset.
   - Success criteria (quant + qual): what counts as a win (examples below).

2) Proposed success criteria (draft):
   - Automated metrics: top-1 exact-answer match >= 65% on held-out prompts; ROUGE-L >= 0.45 for free-form answers.
   - Human eval: average helpfulness >= 4.0/5 on n=100 samples.
   - Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms per token for typical request sizes.
   - Cost target: < $0.30 per 1k output tokens (goal, not blocking).

3) Timeline (proposed):
   - Apr 21: kickoff and ingestion smoke test
   - Apr 22–28: ingestion + initial eval runs
   - Apr 29–May 8: iterated tuning (prompt engineering, caching/batching config)
   - May 12: POC wrap, results + recommendations

4) Ownership (Redwood):
   - Monica: data ingestion + smoke tests
   - Aditya: evaluation harness + dashboard
   - Me (Diego): overall POC coordination, commercial/contract touchpoints

5) Next steps (action items):
   - Ellen: share prompt CSV + redacted chat logs and confirm any data sharing constraints (legal).
   - Monica: will send a short ingestion checklist and template by tomorrow.
   - Aditya: will draft the evaluation plan and metrics dashboard.

Attaching a small prompt_submission_template.csv to make schema easy. If timeline needs to shift, tell us your target week.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Green <ellen.green@greenleaf.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Brookes <sam.brookes@greenleaf.ai>, legal@greenleaf.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC intake: prompt & evaluation data — next steps and owners

Thanks Diego — appreciate the clear plan. We're aligned on the high level and attaching our first pass of the materials: greenleaf_prompts_v1.csv and a redacted sample of chat logs (chat_logs_redacted.json).

A few notes from our side:
- The prompts file includes an internal intent_tag column; we didn’t add expected_answer for all rows (we can add a small subset for evaluation).
- Legal is reviewing the data share — they asked that personally identifiable information be removed; we redacted names and account numbers in the attached JSON but kept timestamps. Let us know if you need more aggressive hashing.
- We can commit to the kickoff week of Apr 21; Sam will be our internal POC lead on Greenleaf's side.

I'll drop the Drive link once legal clears the sharing permission. Thanks — look forward to Monica's checklist.

Best,
Ellen
Director of Product | Greenleaf Health

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Green <ellen.green@greenleaf.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC intake: prompt & evaluation data — next steps and owners

Hi Ellen —

Thanks for the files, these look good for an initial smoke test. Quick ingestion checklist I ran locally and will formalize as a file (attached ingest_checklist.md):

- Schema expectations for prompt CSV: columns = prompt_id, prompt_text, intent_tag (optional), expected_answer (optional), source_channel
- Encoding: UTF-8, no multi-line cells (we can accept newline-escaped tokens if needed)
- Chat logs: JSONL preferred (one JSON object per line), remove PII, replace account ids with hashed_id
- File naming: greenleaf_prompts_v1.csv (we can accept versioned names)
- Access: either a Drive folder with editor access for redwood-inference@redwoodinference.com or s3:// access with temporary creds

Plan on running a small smoke ingestion within 24 hours of access. If ingestion fails, I'll send a short error report and a recommended fix.

Also, for the human eval samples Aditya will need at least 100 prompt-answer pairs with gold labels (if you have them). If not, we'll sample and do a human-rated batch.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Green <ellen.green@greenleaf.ai>, Sam Brookes <sam.brookes@greenleaf.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC intake: prompt & evaluation data — next steps and owners

Quick update and a refined evaluation plan (please confirm these are reasonable on your side):

Evaluation plan summary:
- Dataset: use provided prompts (~500) with a 80/20 train/holdout split; holdout used only for final scoring.
- Automated metrics: top-1 exact match, ROUGE-L, normalized BLEU for short answers.
- Human evaluation: n=100 randomly sampled holdout items, rated for helpfulness (1-5) and factuality (Yes/No).
- Acceptance thresholds (draft): exact-match >= 65%; human helpfulness >= 4.0 avg; no systemic factual errors in >5% of samples.

Operational targets:
- Ingestion smoke test by Apr 22 (Monica)
- First automated run by Apr 24 (Aditya)
- Dashboard + human eval by May 6
- Final POC review with exec summary by May 12

Ownership table (please confirm):
- Greenleaf: Sam Brookes — internal data owner and legal contact
- Redwood: Monica — ingestion & runtime config; Aditya — eval & dashboard; Diego — POC coordination and contract follow-up

Commercial note: I've attached a short POC SOW draft (POC_SOW_DRAFT.docx) that mirrors this timeline and deliverables. If Greenleaf's legal requires an NDA/ amendment, we can accommodate — Diego will coordinate with our legal team.

Please confirm Sam will be the single point of contact and drop the Drive/S3 link when legal is finished. Once we have access Monica will run a smoke test and report back.

Thanks,
Diego

From: Ellen Green <ellen.green@greenleaf.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Brookes <sam.brookes@greenleaf.ai>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC intake: prompt & evaluation data — next steps and owners

Diego / team —

Confirming: Sam will be our POC lead; legal has the SOW and is drafting a short data addendum / NDA — should be back to you by Monday. Sharing Drive folder now (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-greenleaf-poc) with editor access for redwood-inference@redwoodinference.com. Files uploaded: greenleaf_prompts_v1.csv, chat_logs_redacted.json.

We're good to kick off on Apr 21 — please go ahead and schedule the kickoff meeting (30 min). Looking forward to the smoke test results.

Thanks,
Ellen
